description: Defines classes RefImsMedia and RefImsMediaSession which extend Android radio IMS media interfaces, including method declarations for IMS media session management and media control.

classes.name: RefImsMedia
classes.description: A class extending RadioImsMedia, providing implementations for IMS media control methods such as setListener, openSession, and closeSession.

classes.name: RefImsMediaSession
classes.description: A class extending RadioImsMediaSession, providing methods for session management, media modification, DTMF signaling, and header extensions.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets the media listener for IMS media or session.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens an IMS media session with specified session ID, local endpoint, and RTP configuration.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes the specified IMS media session.

methods.name: modifySession
methods.description: Modifies the current IMS media session with new RTP configuration.

methods.name: sendDtmf
methods.description: Sends a DTMF tone with specified digit and duration.

methods.name: stopDtmf
methods.description: Stops sending the current DTMF tone.

methods.name: setMediaQualityThreshold
methods.description: Sets the media quality threshold for the session.
